Requested revision of the violet star theme: keep the dusky violet/lavender family and soft scalloped fabric canopy with ivory piping, but REMOVE EVERY five-point star, crescent, constellation line and modern geometric symbol from canopy, lamps, apron, stools, menu, plate, pot and handle. Replace with traditional Chinese delicate FOLDED-BRANCH BLOSSOM AND LEAF decoration, akin to gentle bamboo-leaf and osmanthus game skins. Color: restrained wisteria-violet #786591, warm oat ivory #F0E2C9 and tiny pale gold stamens. Canopy has only two airy off-center cream/lilac flowering twigs framing the wooden sign, each a small natural curved branch with a few simple rounded blossoms and leaves, leaving at least 75 percent of cloth undecorated. No dense print, no giant flower emblem. Both lantern paper bodies muted lavender with a SMALL vertical flowering twig only 20-25 percent of lantern body width, offset slightly to one side, thin gold fittings and violet tassels; plenty of blank paper. Apron muted deep violet with tiny blossom stitching at pocket corner, not a large badge. Both stools plain muted violet plastic, narrow ivory seat lip, NO dots, badges or flowers on front legs. Pot warm cream with a narrow lilac floral band, plate cream with a few tiny violet buds at edge, menu frame simple violet with tiny curved leaf at top corner. Wok handle end-cap plain violet. Fixed wood natural medium warm walnut. Overall gentle ancient-style floral stall, NOT astrology, NOT candy purple, NOT grand palace ornament.
